description: The arrangement report, arrangement.json (ADR-362 section 9), format 2: what arrangement.html shows, one section a topic and one a subtopic since ADR-409 section 7.

format.description: The report's own format, from 1; raised by a change that removes, renames or retypes a field. 2 since ADR-409 section 7 renamed the headline's partitions to topics and the sections partition-<n> to topic-<n> and topic-<n>-subtopic-<m>.

writtenAt.description: The instant it was written, in UTC to the millisecond.

headline.description: The few numbers the page states first, in order: topics (the topic sections, one for each topic with documents under it), clusters (groups on the page) and documents (documents in them), each a count.

key.description: topics, labelled Topics; clusters, labelled Groups; or documents, labelled Documents.

unit.description: count, the unit of all three.

sections.description: The page's parts in its order: overview and approval, then topic-<n>, one for each topic in topic order, <n> its place counted from 1, each topic with subtopics followed directly by topic-<n>-subtopic-<m>, one for each of its subtopics in subtopic order, <m> its place counted from 1; or nothing where nothing was arranged. A section of a topic without subtopics, and of a subtopic, has a table of its groups with the columns group (text), documents (count) and namedAfter (path, the lead document, absolute); a section of a topic with subtopics has none, its groups being its subtopics'. The approval's text holds the name to approve as the paragraph that stands alone.

id.description: overview, approval, topic-<n>, topic-<n>-subtopic-<m> or nothing.

title.description: The section's title; a topic's and a subtopic's is the name recorded for it under the arrangement run.

text.description: Its paragraphs. For a topic or a subtopic whose name fell back, the paragraph saying why the naming model's name was not used comes first; then, for a topic without subtopics and for a subtopic, its line of counts. A topic with subtopics has no line of counts.

chart.description: No section of this report draws a chart.

table.description: Its table; null where it holds none, as a topic with subtopics does.

id.description: Its id: group, documents or namedAfter.

rows.description: Its rows, each a list of cells in the columns' order.

items.description: One row: the cluster's label, its document count and its lead document's absolute path.
One cell: a string or a number.
